implement.approach: Regression first (commit 51543dff, 22/23 fail on BASE), then the fix (commit e8311398). rateLimit.ts: refusals are tagged AuthFailureKind = credential | liveness | local (authRefusal/authRefusalOf on the Response; authRefusalKind maps GoTrue error_code: session_not_found/session_expired/user_not_found/user_banned/refresh_token_already_used => liveness, anything else => credential). Budget keys are sha256(credential)[:32] shards per egress ('authfail_id') plus the egress-wide stuffing budget ('authfail'). chargeAuthFailure: credential => charge the credential shard every time and the egress budget only on that identity's FIRST refusal (fixes r2 break #1: beyond the shard cap a replay no longer charges the egress per request); liveness => credential shard only; local => nothing for a route credential, or the per-egress anonymous shard ('anon') when no session-shaped bearer was presented (fixes r2 break #2: no-bearer / garbage / lowercase-scheme junk is throttled in its own lane, never consumes the venue budget, and cannot fence session bearers or bootstrap). peekAuthFailureBudget gates on anonymous shard (if anonymous) + presented credential shard. Atomic window-aligned Redis INCR, bounded memory fallback (MEMORY_WINDOW_MAX), hash-only identities preserved. index.ts wiring is the smallest hunk: tag the 401s, gate on the sharded budget, refresh gates/charges on its refresh token identity.

Fix: rateLimit.ts now classifies refusals (`authRefusalKind` on GoTrue bodies: local / liveness / credential), hashes the presented credential (`authFailureIdentity`), keeps the auth-failure budget per ip+credential shard in a separate fail-OPEN memory store (`MemoryWindows(0)`, attacker-controlled cardinality can never fence bystanders; the server-keyed store keeps failing CLOSED), counts the per-egress `authfail` signal once per DISTINCT refused credential (only kind=credential, only on the shard's first hit, written to the store the shard landed in so a Redis miss cannot multiply one replay per isolate), and exposes `peekAuthFailureBudget` (own shard), `peekAuthStuffing` (egress) and `chargeAuthFailure`; refusal tags ride a WeakMap on the Response — nothing on the wire. index.ts wiring (minimal, serial group held): every 401 tagged; the flat gate is replaced by a per-credential peek; `authenticate()` checks the stuffing signal only AFTER the auth-cache lookup so verified sessions are never gated by co-tenants while unverified bearers on an egress under stuffing are 429 before Auth; `refreshSessionRoute` shards on the body refresh token (not an unrelated bearer header); liveness 401s (cache-revoked, session_not_found, provider-less session, revocation race) charge only their own shard. Auth outages (5xx/429/network/malformed 2xx) still return 503 + Retry-After and charge nothing.
